description: Physical-AI-Driving-Safety event record. One row per event (not per frame).

data_source.SYNTHETIC_COMBINATION: real streams combined although they were NOT recorded together

observation_type.OBSERVED: event is a change in an observed signal

record_provenance.separation: SYNTHETIC and SYNTHETIC_COMBINATION records are written to a separate dataset root and are rejected by the real-dataset writer.

field_provenance.INFERRED: derived from observations by tracker / rules

units: Image-space pixels and seconds. No metres, physical speed, distance or TTC anywhere.

fields.name: schema_version
fields.description: Event schema version.

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Sequential id within a run: event_000001, event_000002, ... (deterministic).

fields.name: run_id
fields.description: Identifier of the recording/processing run that produced the event.

fields.name: session_id
fields.description: Stream the event belongs to (e.g. the source video's file stem).

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: Source file name (no directory), when the stream is a file.

fields.name: camera
fields.description: Which camera stream(s) the event is based on.

fields.name: data_source
fields.description: LOCAL_REAL (our own captures) | PUBLIC | SYNTHETIC (constructed test inputs) | SYNTHETIC_COMBINATION (real streams combined although not recorded together). Synthetic records live in a separate dataset.

fields.name: observation_type
fields.description: INFERRED when the event is derived from inferred quantities (all risk / hazard events); OBSERVED only for a DRIVER_STATE_CHANGE of the observed hand state.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.description: Stream time of the event, seconds (video timestamps for files).

fields.name: frame_index
fields.description: Index of the frame that produced the event, when known.

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: Kind of event.

fields.name: transition
fields.description: FROM->TO for level and driver-state changes, e.g. SAFE->CAUTION.

fields.name: previous_risk_level
fields.description: Risk level before a level change.

fields.name: change_kind
fields.description: For DRIVER_STATE_CHANGE: hand_state | driver_activity | drowsiness_level.

fields.name: gps_lat
fields.description: Latitude from a real GPS source; null when unavailable. Never invented.

fields.name: gps_lon
fields.description: Longitude from a real GPS source; null when unavailable. Never invented.

fields.name: gps_source
fields.description: GPS source name, or UNAVAILABLE.

fields.name: gps_timestamp
fields.description: Time of the GPS fix used, seconds (same clock as timestamp).

fields.name: gps_accuracy_m
fields.description: Reported GPS accuracy in metres, when the source provides it.

fields.name: risk_level
fields.description: Risk level after hysteresis (decision-support state, not validated).

fields.name: raw_risk_score
fields.description: Rule-based prototype score 0-100 for this observation. Not a probability.

fields.name: smoothed_risk_score
fields.description: Smoothed prototype score 0-100. Not a probability.

fields.name: hazard_type
fields.description: Risk engine hazard type (NONE, APPROACHING_VEHICLE, ...).

fields.name: primary_track_id
fields.description: Tracker id of the object driving the hazard (identity is inferred).

fields.name: image_width
fields.description: Front-camera frame width in pixels.

fields.name: image_height
fields.description: Front-camera frame height in pixels.

fields.name: hazard_class
fields.description: Detector label of the primary object at the event time.

fields.name: hazard_track_class
fields.description: Track-level label (most frequent detector label of the track).

fields.name: hazard_class_changes
fields.description: Detector label changes observed on the primary track.

fields.name: hazard_confidence
fields.description: Detector confidence of the primary object at the event time.

fields.name: track_persistence_seconds
fields.description: How long the primary track has been observed.

fields.name: track_detection_count
fields.description: Detections supporting the primary track.

fields.name: center_x
fields.description: Primary object box centre x, pixels.

fields.name: center_y
fields.description: Primary object box centre y, pixels.

fields.name: bbox_width
fields.description: Primary object box width, pixels.

fields.name: bbox_height
fields.description: Primary object box height, pixels.

fields.name: bbox_area
fields.description: Primary object box area, pixels².

fields.name: velocity_x_pixels_per_second
fields.description: Image-space centre velocity x (not physical speed).

fields.name: velocity_y_pixels_per_second
fields.description: Image-space centre velocity y (not physical speed).

fields.name: area_change_rate
fields.description: Box area change, pixels² per second (tracker, frame to frame).

fields.name: box_growth_per_second
fields.description: Risk-engine growth: slope of ln(box area) over ~1 s (relative approach signal, not distance).

fields.name: lateral_toward_center_fw_per_s
fields.description: Horizontal motion toward/across the central image band, frame-widths per second.

fields.name: trajectory_overlap
fields.description: Reserved: overlap of the object's path with the vehicle's projected path. Always null until a calibrated path model exists.

fields.name: hazard_persistence
fields.description: How long this hazard (same hazard type and track) has been continuously reported, seconds.

fields.name: driver_hand_state
fields.description: Hand-state classifier output (BOTH_HANDS / ONE_HAND / NO_HANDS / UNKNOWN).

fields.name: driver_hand_confidence
fields.description: Hand-state classifier confidence.

fields.name: driver_activity
fields.description: Inferred driver activity (NORMAL, HANDS_OFF_WHEEL, ...).

fields.name: drowsiness_level
fields.description: Temporal drowsiness level (prototype, not medically validated).

fields.name: drowsiness_score
fields.description: Temporal drowsiness score 0-1 (prototype).

fields.name: face_status
fields.description: Driver face-landmark status for the frame.

fields.name: risk_reason
fields.description: Reason generated by the rule engine from structured factors (no LLM).

fields.name: risk_factors
fields.description: Contributing factors [{name, points, source, detail, track_id}].

fields.name: risk_gates
fields.description: Level caps applied by the risk engine.

fields.name: evidence_quality
fields.description: 0-1 support of the evidence behind the risk result (not a probability).

fields.name: alarm_recommended
fields.description: Risk engine recommendation (level >= configured alarm level).

fields.name: alarm_triggered
fields.description: Whether an alarm was actually raised. Always false: no alarm output exists yet.

fields.name: evidence_kind
fields.description: NONE | FRAME (single images) | CLIP (video clips).

fields.name: evidence_path
fields.description: Evidence directory relative to the event dataset root: <run_id>/<event_id>.

fields.name: evidence_files
fields.description: Evidence files relative to the event dataset root.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Provenance and limitation notes for this record.
